items.text: Cleveland activated QB Dillon Gabriel (back) from IR and now carries four QBs; Deshaun Watson has started all seven games and is expected to remain the starter.
Cleveland DT Mason Graham briefly limped off in Week 7 but returned; DL Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) missed the game.

Pittsburgh: EDGE T.J. Watt was dinged but returned in Week 7; WR Ben Skowronek (calf) and CB Brandin Echols (hamstring) were out; DL Sebastian Joseph-Day went on IR (triceps). WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) remains on IR.
